Agent Island v0.12.1 fixes native permission cards and adds a visual introduction with a 15-second demo.

### Fix

- Fix a WPF logical-parent error when rendering permission cards. Allow/Deny controls can now appear without reparenting the same content twice.
- The isolated showcase regression test renders the real card and invokes its Allow button, then verifies the decision was answered. Existing backend tests also verify the Claude Code hook response.

### See it before you download

- Updated English and Chinese README: native UI animation, three feature screenshots, a downloadable MP4, and a clear three-step setup.
- Compatibility descriptions distinguish Codex session monitoring from integrations that require hooks or API events. Codex approvals still need to be handled in Codex.
- All public demo data is synthetic. The media renderer does not capture the desktop, start session/process monitoring, read clipboard/Windows notifications, load normal settings/todos, or open an HTTP listener.

### Downloads

- **self-contained ZIP (recommended):** includes the .NET desktop runtime.
- **framework-dependent ZIP:** requires .NET 8 Desktop Runtime x64.

Windows 10/11 x64. Extract the whole ZIP, verify the matching SHA-256 file, and run `AgentIsland.Native.exe`. Builds remain unsigned; Windows may show an unknown-publisher warning.

Exit the previous app before starting this one. Settings and todos are reused; old releases remain available. No telemetry or automatic upload was added. Clipboard history remains a first-run choice, and notification capture/removal remain off for new installations. The local event API is not authenticated against other local programs.
